remarks: Fully renovated and move-in ready, this 2-bedroom condo in the serene Fairlawn complex with an stress-free lifestyle! Featuring an updated kitchen, modern bathroom, hardwood floors, and abundant natural light, the unit includes two spacious bedrooms with large closets and an in-unit washer/dryer (comb). The HOA covers heat, hot and cold water, snow removal, lawn care, trash, and a storage unit. Pet-friendly and tenant-friendly, the condo comes with 2 parking permits, plus additional laundry and storage facilities in the building. Located just minutes from bus lines, I-95, shops, restaurants, parks, beaches, schools, downtown Stamford, and the train station. Don't miss this opportunity! Special Assessment(retro oil) $56 will sunset in May 2026.
